hero_assets.name: Private distributed learning
hero_assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a standalone concept illustration for the Security research tab of SMART'ILIA, the University of Mons AI research laboratory.
Primary request: three equal peer computing devices arranged in a compact triangular ring and connected by short steel-blue links. Each device is a precise pale-grey square processor tile with a burgundy central chip. One small upright burgundy padlock sits in the open centre, signifying protected model updates shared between peers. All three peers are equal, with no dominant central server. This is a clear conceptual emblem of private distributed AI learning.
Style: refined sculptural technical miniature, orthographic isometric three-quarter 3D view, matte ceramic and softly brushed metal, crisp engineered shapes, soft upper-left studio lighting, restrained burgundy #8B1538, steel blue #335E77 and pale warm grey #E8E7E4. The style must suit a sober university research site and match a series of matte isometric project illustrations.
Composition: one tight cohesive group centred on a square canvas, fills about 85%, all objects fully visible. Genuinely transparent alpha including gaps. No badge, surrounding frame, floor, backdrop, distant objects or cast floor shadow.
No text, lettering, numbers, logos, watermark, people, faces, neon, purple, holograms or photographic research results. This is an illustrative metaphor, not an experiment or real hardware photograph.
